info.name: Returns rooms and information about them. If you don’t specify any query parameters besides the token, all rooms will be returned.

params.name: roomname
params.description: Every site (building) has a name. In some cases this is contained in the roomname as well.

params.name: roomid
params.description: The room ID (not to be confused with the roomname).

params.name: siteid
params.description: Every room is inside a site (building). All sites have IDs.

params.name: sitename
params.description: Every site (building) has a name. In some cases this is contained in the roomname as well.

params.name: capacity
params.description: Every room has a set capacity of how many people can fit inside it. When supplied, all rooms with the given capacity or greater will be returned.

items.docs: Returns rooms and information about them. If you don’t specify any query parameters besides the token, all rooms will be returned.

info.name: Returns the results to a bookings or space availability query. It returns a paginated list of bookings. Note that this endpoint only returns publicly displayed bookings. Departmental bookings are not included.

params.name: roomname
params.description: Every site (building) has a name. In some cases this is contained in the roomname as well.

params.name: roomid
params.description: The room ID (not to be confused with the roomname).

params.name: start_datetime
params.description: Start datetime of the booking. Returns bookings with a start_datetime after the one supplied. Follows the ISO 8601 formatting standard.

params.name: end_datetime
params.description: End datetime of the booking. Returns bookings with an end_datetime before the one supplied. Follows the ISO 8601 formatting standard.

params.name: date
params.description: Date of the bookings you need, in the format YYYYMMDD. Returns bookings occurring on this day. This query parameter is only considered when end_datetime and start_datetime are not supplied.

params.name: siteid
params.description: Every room is inside a site (building). All sites have IDs.

params.name: description
params.description: Describes what the booking is. Could contain a module code (for example WIBRG005) or just the type of activity (for example Lecture).

params.name: contact
params.description: The name of the person who made the booking. Substrings of the contact name can be used, Queries for Mark will include Mark Herbster. Sometimes, a society or student group may be the contact for a booking.

params.name: results_per_page
params.description: Number of bookings returned per page. Maximum allowed value is 1000. Defaults to 1000.

items.docs: Returns the results to a bookings or space availability query. It returns a paginated list of bookings. Note that this endpoint only returns publicly displayed bookings. Departmental bookings are not included.

info.name: Returns any equipment/feature information about a specific room. So, for example whether there is a Whiteboard or a DVD Player in the room. A full example can be seen here.

params.name: roomid
params.description: The room ID (not to be confused with the roomname).

params.name: siteid
params.description: Every room is inside a site (building). All sites have IDs.

items.docs: Returns any equipment/feature information about a specific room. So, for example whether there is a Whiteboard or a DVD Player in the room. A full example can be seen here.

info.name: Given a start time and an end time, this endpoint returns all rooms which are free in that time range.

params.name: start_datetime
params.description: Start datetime of the booking. Returns bookings with a start_datetime after the one supplied. Follows the ISO 8601 formatting standard.

params.name: end_datetime
params.description: End datetime of the booking. Returns bookings with an end_datetime before the one supplied. Follows the ISO 8601 formatting standard.

items.docs: Given a start time and an end time, this endpoint returns all rooms which are free in that time range.
